condition: Warfarin may increase the anticoagulant activities of Acetylsalicylic acid.
Acetaminophen may increase the anticoagulant activities of Warfarin, leading to bleeding.
Ibuprofen may increase the anticoagulant activities of Warfarin.
The risk or severity of bleeding can be increased when Warfarin is combined with Ibuprofen.
The risk or severity of gastrointestinal bleeding can be increased when Ibuprofen is combined with Acetylsalicylic acid.
Omeprazole may increase the serum concentration of Digoxin.
Metformin may decrease the excretion rate of Cetirizine.
Omeprazole may decrease the metabolism of Loratadine.
The risk or severity of lactic acidosis can be increased when Ethanol is combined with Metformin.
